name: Zach Edey
headline: Zach Edey is an efficient, rebound-first big on a short leash, and he just had his quietest game of the year.
good: He is averaging 7.7 rebounds in only 20.8 minutes over 10 games, including 2.6 offensive boards a night.
He scores efficiently: 51.9% from the field, 87.5% at the line and a 60.7% true shooting mark on just a 15.5% usage rate.
Memphis is plus 6.4 per game with him on the floor (plus 64 total), and he has had double-digit boards in 2 games, including 13 against Indiana.
His grade is a B+ (73) with the note 'elite production for his minutes', and he adds 1.3 blocks a game.
bad: He disappeared against Denver on Wednesday: 2 points on 1-of-4 shooting and 5 rebounds in 20 minutes of a 123-118 loss.
Scoring is modest at 7.6 points a game, and he gives it back with 1.4 turnovers, including 3 against Toronto and 3 against Utah on Oct 27.
He sat out the Oct 26 Sacramento game, and Memphis has lost 4 of its last 5 games with him mostly in the 19 to 25 minute range.
fans: I could not find recent fan threads or beat-writer pieces dated to the last few weeks, so this is thin. Older coverage, such as Sports Info Solutions and SI, keeps landing on the same point: his value is rebounding, rim protection and efficiency, and Memphis plays better with him on the floor. Fantasy outlets also flag that the addition of Cameron Boozer could shape his role.
outlook: Memphis (7-4) visits the Pelicans (4-8) tonight, with the Grizzlies favored by 3.5. Edey lost a 135-134 game to New Orleans on Nov 3 where he grabbed 9 rebounds, 6 of them offensive, so expect another steady rebounding night in roughly 20 minutes.
